name: Abegail Shane Gacho
today_message: May this day be filled with the things that make you smile, the people who make you feel loved, and little moments you'll always remember.
letter_title: To my favorite girl, Bebe Shane 💌
message:
Happy 22nd birthday! 🎂

Before anything else — thank you. Thank you for coming into my life, for every laugh we've shared, every late-night talk, and every little moment that turned an ordinary day into a happy one. Meeting you is honestly one of the best things that has ever happened to me, and I'm grateful for you every single day.

You have the kindest heart, the prettiest smile, and a way of making people feel at home. Never let anyone make you feel like you're anything less than amazing — because you are.

As you begin this new chapter, I want you to know one thing for sure: I'm always on your side. I'll cheer the loudest when you win, I'll stay close when things get hard, and I'll keep believing in you even on the days you forget to believe in yourself. Whatever you dream of, go for it — I'll be right here supporting you, always.

Enjoy your day, eat lots of cake, and let yourself feel how loved you are. You deserve every bit of happiness this world can give. 💖
just_for_you:
There's something I've wanted to tell you for a long time, and today feels like the perfect day to say it. You are one of the kindest, most genuine people I know. You make ordinary days feel special just by being in them.

You don't have to be perfect to be someone wonderful — being yourself is already more than enough. Enjoy every step you take, celebrate every win no matter how small, and don't forget to rest when you're tired.

Wishing you endless happiness, beautiful memories, and all the good things life has to offer.
closing: That's all for this little surprise. I hope this small page made you smile, even just for a moment. Thank you for taking the time to read it until the end. May today be the start of many more good things to come, and may happiness always find its way to you.
